novice.takeaway: A sample is a finite collection of n observations, and its mean is the average found by adding the observations and dividing by n.
novice.inferred_claim: Use the sample mean to describe a sample’s average.

peer.takeaway: A sample contains n observations, and its mean x̄ is their average: the sum of all xi values divided by n.
peer.inferred_claim: Use x̄ to denote the arithmetic average of a sample.

expert.takeaway: The slide defines a sample as n observations and defines its sample mean as the arithmetic average, \(\bar{x}=n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^{n}x_i\).
expert.inferred_claim: Use the sample mean as the standard average of observed data.
